title: Crew of Bakshi Productions, 1981
content: Top row from left: Pat Capozzi, Jack Ozark, A (Unknown), Sue Shigida, B, Mitch Rochon, C, John Sparey, Steve Gordon, Bruce Woodside, James Gurney, D, Tom Tataranowicz, Jan Cummings, Thomas Kinkade.Bottom Row: Bill Recinos, Debbie Hayes, Mike Svayko, Tim Callahan, Mauro Maressa, Ralph Bakshi, Frank Frazetta, E.Ralph Bakshi Productions crew photo in 1981, during the production of the animated film "Fire and Ice."Here's the trailer (Link to YouTube).Behind-the-scenes:Part 1: Fire and Ice -- RekindledPart 2: Fire and Ice -- Frank FrazettaPart 3: Fire and Ice -- Tom KinkadePart 4: Fire and Ice -- Ralph BakshiPart 5: Living Inside PaintingsWikipedia onRalph BakshiWikipedia on the originalFire and Ice.
